thread_text:
pat: FYI canary of SDK 4.0 shows deserialization errors for >2048 tokens. proposing scoped runtime pin for model-group:longseq tonight (21:30 UTC) to avoid Dedicated impact.

lee: paste log?

pat: log:
```
2026-03-22T20:40:01Z ERROR deserialize: token overflow at seq>2048
model: llama3q-2.7.3-quant
runtime: 3.5.1
sdk: 4.0.0-canary
```

sasha: triage: only quant longseqs hit it. ops recommends pin.

pat: plan: deploybot pin add --id pb-9923 --runtime runtime:3.5.0-stable --scope "model-group:longseq" --duration 3h --meta "reason:SDK4-deserialize-longseq" at 21:30 UTC. monitor parser-error-rate and p95 latency. rollback if error >1% for 20m.

deploybot: scheduled pb-9923 for 2026-03-22T21:30:00Z by pat.

deploybot: executed pb-9923 at 2026-03-22T21:30:12Z 1 pin active.

srebot: alert rule: longseq-deserialize-error >0.5% over 5m -> page oncall.

lee: watching telemetry now. initial drop in errors after pin.

pat: update after 90m: stable, no customer pages. plan to lift at 00:30 UTC unless owners request.

deploybot: removed pb-9923 at 2026-03-23T00:30:05Z 1 pin removed.

srebot: pb-9923 logged lifecycle. no escalations.

sasha: relnote added: "Temporary runtime pin to protect longseq traffic during SDK 4.0 rollout."

pat: thanks team, closing thread.
